prompt: Write the function merge(intervals) in /work/intervals.py. The argument is a list of (start, end) tuples of ints, and each tuple is the half-open interval [start, end). Return a new list of tuples, sorted by start, in which no two intervals overlap or touch: merge two intervals when they overlap or when the end of one equals the start of the other. Drop empty intervals (start == end); an empty interval never joins two other intervals. Raise ValueError if any interval has start > end. Do not modify the input list. The visible tests are run with: python3 -m pytest -q test_intervals.py
